newsitem.title: USA: Claire's Stores Dunavant buys 20,000 shrs.
newsitem.headline: Claire's Stores Dunavant buys 20,000 shrs.

text.p: Claire's Stores Inc said on Friday Leslie Dunavant, president and chief operating officer of Claire's Boutiques Inc unit, bought 20,000 shares of the company's common stock because stock was undervalued.
Dunavant also acquired 45,000 shares early in December through exercise of an option, the company said.
"Our stock is significantly undervalued," Dunavant said. "I think some people are underestimating how well we did during the Christmas selling season and during fiscal 1997 overall to date."
Dunavant said investors could be in for "some pleasant surprises" when the year is completed on February 1.
